paper.title: Locally Private Nonparametric Contextual Multi-armed Bandits

settings.name_in_paper: Nonparametric contextual MAB under local differential privacy
unmapped: Contexts in [0,1]^d with nonparametric reward functions f_k(x) that are Lipschitz in the context (constant C_L)
Context marginal density bounded above and below (c r^d <= P_X(B(x,r)) <= c' r^d)
Margin condition with exponent beta (beta <= d) on the gap between best and second-best reward functions
Sequentially-interactive epsilon-local differential privacy on (context, arm, reward) of each user
settings.definition_quote: Let domain $\mathcal{X} = [0,1]^d$, number of arms $K$ ... At time $t$, based on the covariate $X_{t}^{\mathrm{P}}$ drawn from the marginal distribution $\mathrm{P}_{X}$, an arm $k\in[K]$ is selected and one receives a random reward $Y_{t}^{\mathrm{P},(k)} \in [0, 1]$ ... Under LDP, the raw information $Z_t^{\mathrm{P}} = (X_t^{\mathrm{P}}, k, Y_t^{\mathrm{P}, (k)})$ of user $t$ needs to be privatized

settings.name_in_paper: LDP nonparametric contextual MAB with auxiliary data under covariate shift (transfer learning)
unmapped: Contexts in [0,1]^d with nonparametric Lipschitz reward functions, bounded context density, margin condition with exponent beta <= d
M auxiliary offline datasets of size n_Q_m collected by fixed behavior policies with exploration coefficient kappa_m, under covariate shift with transfer exponent gamma_m (same reward functions)
Each auxiliary dataset is accessed under its own eps_m-LDP constraint; target data under eps-LDP
The learner knows the auxiliary privacy budgets eps_m and sample sizes n_Q_m (not kappa_m, gamma_m)
settings.definition_quote: we assume that there are $M \in \mathbb{Z}_+$ auxiliary datasets $\mathcal{D}^{\mathrm{Q}_1}, \dots, \mathcal{D}^{\mathrm{Q}_M}$ ... We allow the target data policy $\pi$ to receive information from $\mathcal{D}^{\mathrm{Q}_m}$ via a sequentially-interactive $\varepsilon_m$-LDP mechanism.

algorithms.name: LDPMAB (Algorithm 2: nonparametric MAB algorithm under LDP, adaptive binning with arm elimination and Laplace mechanism)
LDPMAB with auxiliary data (Algorithm 3: jump-start with reweighted multi-source estimator)

conditions: policies in the class Pi(epsilon) of sequentially-interactive epsilon-LDP policies
margin condition with exponent beta, beta <= d

source.label: thm:lower-bound
source.quote: \inf_{\pi \in \Pi(\varepsilon)}\sup_{\substack{\Lambda(K,\beta )}}\mathbb{E}[R_{n_\mathrm{P}}(\pi)] \geq  c n_{\mathrm{P}} \Big\{  n_{\mathrm{P}} (e^\varepsilon - 1)^2  \wedge {n_{\mathrm{P}}}^{\frac{2 + 2d}{2 + d}}\Big\}^{-\frac{1+\beta}{2 + 2d }}, where $c>0$ is an absolute constant depending only on $d$, $C_L$ and $\beta$.

results.notes: Regret defined via conditional expectation of f differences over contexts, i.e., pseudo-regret vs per-context optimal arm. Lower bound is over all eps-LDP policies; independent of K.

conditions: policies in the class Pi(epsilon) of sequentially-interactive epsilon-LDP policies
margin condition with exponent beta, beta <= d

source.label: thm:lower-bound
source.quote: In particular, when $0< \varepsilon \leq 1$, it holds with an absolute constant $c' > 0$ that \inf_{\pi \in \Pi(\varepsilon)} \sup_{\substack{\Lambda(K,\beta )}}\mathbb{E}[R_{n_\mathrm{P}}(\pi)] \geq  c' n_{\mathrm{P}} \left(  n_{\mathrm{P}} \varepsilon^2  \right)^{-\frac{1+\beta}{2 + 2d }}.

conditions: P in Lambda(K, beta): Lipschitz reward functions, bounded context density, margin condition with exponent beta (beta <= d)

source.label: thm:upper-bound
source.quote: the policy $\pi$ given by \Cref{alg:ldpmabofP} satisfies $\pi \in \Pi(\varepsilon)$ and with probability at least $1 -  n_{\mathrm{P}}^{-2}$, R_{n_{\mathrm{P}}}(\pi) \leq C  n_{\mathrm{P}} \Bigg\{ \left(\frac{n_{\mathrm{P}} \varepsilon^2}{K^2\log (n_{\mathrm{P}})} \right) \wedge \left(\frac{n_{\mathrm{P}}}{K \log (n_{\mathrm{P}}) }\right)^{\frac{2 + 2d}{2 + d}}\Bigg\}^{-\frac{1+\beta}{2 + 2d }}

results.notes: Failure probability fixed at n_P^{-2}. Regret is sum of conditional expected instantaneous regrets, bound holds w.h.p. over privatized history. Constant depends on d, C_L, beta.

conditions: P in Lambda(K, beta): Lipschitz reward functions, bounded context density, margin condition with exponent beta (beta <= d)

source.label: thm:upper-bound
source.quote: If in addition that $0< \varepsilon \leq 1$, then it holds with an absolute constant $C'>0$ that R_{n_{\mathrm{P}}}(\pi) \leq C'  n_{\mathrm{P}} \left(   \frac{n_{\mathrm{P}} \varepsilon^2}{K^2\log (n_{\mathrm{P}})} \right)^{-\frac{1+\beta}{2 + 2d }}.

bound.expression_latex: c n_{\mathrm{P}} \Bigg[   n_{\mathrm{P}} (e^\varepsilon - 1)^2  \wedge n_{\mathrm{P}}^{\frac{2 + 2d}{2 + d}} + \sum_{m = 1}^{M} \left(\frac{\kappa_m^2 n_{\mathrm{Q}_m}}{K^2} (e^{\varepsilon_m} - 1)^2\right)^{\frac{2 + 2 d}{2  + 2d + 2\gamma_m}} \wedge \left(\frac{\kappa_m n_{\mathrm{Q}_m}}{K}\right)^{\frac{2 + 2 d}{2 + d + \gamma_m}}\Bigg]^{-\frac{1+\beta}{2 + 2d }}

symbols.gamma_m: transfer exponent of Q_m w.r.t. P
symbols.sum_sources: sum over auxiliary datasets m = 1..M of its argument

conditions: policies in Pi(eps, eps_1, ..., eps_M) (LDP w.r.t. target and auxiliary data)

source.quote: \inf_{\pi\in \Pi(\varepsilon, \varepsilon_1, \ldots ,\varepsilon_M)} \sup_{\substack{\Lambda(K,\beta,\gamma,\kappa )}} \mathbb{E}[R_{n_\mathrm{P}}(\pi)] \geq   c n_{\mathrm{P}} \Bigg[   n_{\mathrm{P}} (e^\varepsilon - 1)^2  \wedge n_{\mathrm{P}}^{\frac{2 + 2d}{2 + d}} + \sum_{m = 1}^{M} ... \Bigg]^{-\frac{1+\beta}{2 + 2d }}, where $c>0$ is an absolute constant depending only on $d, C_L, \beta, M, \gamma$.
